repair.contract: rules.charge_error.reference_tick_s_by_case freezes the reference tick per case (TR-120/RS-LOW/TR-LONG/RS-FULL/TR-OFFCODE/RS-SWITCH = 120 ns, TR-200 = 200 ns, DC not applicable); partners share one tick; the nominal tick list 120/200 ns is kept; identity is POC_MEASUREMENT_REFERENCE_NOT_TCON_NOT_DISPLAY_TIMING
repair.convergence: reference_tick_s joins the required pair context and must equal the denominator argument; a pair that agrees on a coarser tick is judged, a denominator that is not a positive finite number is refused, and a drift between the two sides keeps the REFUSED_CONTEXT_CHANGED verdict
repair.defect: measure_case() passed T50 as the QLSB tick too, so a 1 us platform manufactured its own ruler: +0.5 pC on code 111 read 0.266667 LSB and WITHIN_PROPOSED_LIMIT where either nominal tick the contract lists gives 2.222222 / 1.333333 LSB
repair.entrance: reference_tick_for_case() refuses an unknown case, a missing entry, and a zero, negative, non-finite or non-numeric tick by name before any division and never falls back to the window length; charge_errors() keeps T50 for Qexpected and the tick for QLSB and reports reference_tick_s, qlsb_C, t50_s and the map source
rendering: the settling band renders 0.05 as +/-5% instead of +/-0.05% and the numeric tolerance is unchanged
the nominal current table labels A / fA / uA instead of joining bare numbers of different units with equals signs
the R1 report phrase inherited accepted R2 is corrected in this round report: no acceptance registration was authorised
P..R1 is recomputed from the two real endpoints and the R1 record numbers are kept as the moment they were measured
